erin: Quick thread  we need a compact co-sell claim playbook for SDRs + SI leads. keep it <1 page. :clipboard:
jamal: Agreed. Sales is confused about ownership when leads come from marketplace vs. SI intro. we should define default ownership, claim window, and 1-line proof of engagement.
kevin: Draft defaults: marketplace -> redwood-owned; SI-introduced with proof -> SI-owned; SI-requested but no proof -> joint-touch for 7 days then redwood-owned.
tara: Define proof: either a calendar invite with SI on it OR an email thread from SI to buyer that references the opportunity id. anything else is 'no proof'.
erin: ok, what about account mapping? some accounts have multiple SIs or legacy SI relationships.
jamal: mapping idea: CRM field si_primary (single) + si_secondaries (comma list). primary gets first right of refusal. if multiple active SIs, mark as joint-touch.
kevin: add ARR thresholds: >750k -> extended claim window 21 days and notify GTM exec; 250k-750k -> 14 days; <250k -> 7 days. helps protect bigger deals.
tara: demo routing rule: if SI is primary and has reseller or implementation clause -> SI runs technical presales. otherwise redwood presales runs initial demo; SI can join for technical deep-dive at second call.
erin: typo — erin meant to say: erin: +1. also need a fast escalation path when SI claims and rep disputes it.
ops-bot: system: "When SI_claim_dispute is opened -> 24h SLA to resolve. Escalation path: partnerships -> sales ops -> GTM exec" (reaction :alarm_clock:)
jamal: add requirement: SI must submit a 1-paragraph handoff note when claiming a lead: what they did, next steps, primary contacts. block claims without it.
kevin: crediting: if SI performs POC and closes, SI gets origin credit for 12 months. if redwood runs POC but SI introduced, split credit 50/50 by default unless documented evidence shows >60% contribution.
tara: edge case: hardware integrators that supply appliances = automatic joint ownership until appliance provisioning complete. add to exceptions list.
erin: can ops automate claim timers?
ops-bot: yes  we can add claim tags and auto-reassign on expiry. implementable via webhook + scheduled job.
jamal: To ship quickly: 1) publish 1-page playbook, 2) add required CRM fields (si_primary, si_claim_expires, partner_credit_pct), 3) ops add webhook for timers, 4) run 20m training with SDRs + SI leads. owners?
kevin: i'll write the playbook and examples.
tara: i'll update CRM fields and validation rules.
erin: i'll coordinate training and the 20m session.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: "ship SI co-sell playbook v1" on 2025-06-03 09:00 PT
jamal: Thanks all. please add any weird edge cases here (multi-SI, subcontracted consultancies, reseller-with-bundle) and i'll fold them into v1.
